introduction.title: 公司簡介
introduction.subtitle: 豪板實業有限公司成立於台灣台中，專注於高品質室內系統傢俱與建材。
content: 豪板實業有限公司是一家專業的裝飾板材供應商，我們代理歐洲優質 MFC 粒片板，致力於為客戶提供耐用且美觀的產品。
多年來，我們服務住宅與商業空間的設計需求，累積了豐富的經驗與專業知識，成為業界值得信賴的合作夥伴。
我們堅持品質第一的原則，從產品選材到售後服務，每個環節都力求完美，確保客戶獲得最佳的使用體驗。

mission.title: 我們的使命
content: 提供最優質的裝飾板材產品，滿足客戶多樣化的設計需求。
堅持環保理念，選用符合國際標準的環保材料。
提供專業的諮詢服務，協助客戶實現理想空間。

introduction.title: Company Introduction
introduction.subtitle: HAU BOARD Co., Ltd. was established in Taichung, Taiwan, specializing in high-quality interior system furniture and building materials.
content: HAU BOARD Co., Ltd. is a professional decorative panel supplier. We represent premium European MFC particleboard, committed to providing durable and aesthetically pleasing products to our customers.
Over the years, we have served the design needs of residential and commercial spaces, accumulating rich experience and professional knowledge to become a trusted partner in the industry.
We adhere to the principle of quality first. From product selection to after-sales service, we strive for perfection in every aspect to ensure customers receive the best experience.

mission.title: Our Mission
content: Provide the highest quality decorative panel products to meet diverse customer design needs.
Adhere to environmental principles by selecting eco-friendly materials that meet international standards.
Provide professional consultation services to help customers realize their ideal spaces.
